# Model card: `afib_logreg_v1`

*Generated by `make report` from `docs/templates/MODEL_CARD.template.md`. Every number comes from `results/`
or `configs/default.yaml` (sources: `results/readme_numbers.json`).*

> **Research prototype and decision-support tool. Not a medical device and not a diagnosis.** Not validated
> in astronauts, in microgravity or on a real Holter. Trained and tested only on public, terrestrial,
> resting clinical ECGs. These are not NASA or astronaut data.

## Model details

- **Task:** classify one {{win_s}}-s window of single-lead ECG (lead I, {{fs}} Hz, {{win}} samples) as atrial
  fibrillation (AFIB) vs. sinus rhythm. Sinus bradycardia and sinus tachycardia are negatives.
- **Type:** L2-regularised logistic regression on {{n_feat}} hand-crafted features (RR irregularity, P-wave /
  atrial activity, QRS morphology, spectrum), median imputation with missing-value indicators,
  standardisation, Platt calibration. Chosen by a pre-registered rule over random forest, LightGBM and a
  compact 1D CNN (simplest model within {{margin}} validation AUPRC of the best).
- **System around it:** a signal-quality gate (`SINAL_RUIM`), an out-of-distribution / low-confidence state
  (`INCERTO`), {{vote_n}}-of-{{vote_m}} temporal voting for `ALERTA_AFIB`, and a heart-rate rule for mild
  warnings (defaults {{brady}} / {{tachy}} bpm, adapted to personal history).
- **Artifacts:** `models/afib_logreg_v1.json` ({{bench_json_kb}} KB; numpy-only inference via `src/inference.py`)
  and `models/afib_logreg_v1.onnx` ({{bench_onnx_kb}} KB). Metadata include the training commit, the selection
  record and SHA-256 hashes of the source datasets.
- **Input invariance:** offset and scale are removed per window (tested). Raw positive {{adc_bits}}-bit A/D
  values from the target device are accepted directly.

## Intended use

On-board, real-time **early detection of the rhythm present in the current window** during continuous
single-lead ECG recording, to support (not replace) a clinician or flight surgeon. Intended context for
this prototype: research and demonstration (NASA Space Apps Challenge).

**Out of scope:** diagnosis; prediction of future AFIB; myocardial infarction, cardiac arrest or
ventricular arrhythmias (no coverage); atrial flutter (often misclassified, see below); paediatric use;
any clinical deployment.

## Training and evaluation data

- **Training:** Chapman-Shaoxing part of PhysioNet *ecg-arrhythmia* v1.0.0 (Shaoxing only, because the
  Ningbo part has no AFIB), training split of a record-level split (no patient IDs available).
- **Internal test:** held-out Shaoxing split ({{a_n}} windows, {{a_pos}} AFIB).
- **External test:** all of PTB-XL v1.0.3 with AFIB or sinus labels ({{ext_pos}} AFIB, {{ext_neg}} non-AFIB).
- **Stress tests:** Ningbo sinus records, out-of-training rhythms, real noise (MIT-BIH NSTDB).

## Metrics (per window, thresholds frozen on Shaoxing validation)

| Test set | AUROC | Sensitivity [95% CI] | Specificity [95% CI] | PPV | PPV at 1% prevalence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Internal (Shaoxing) | {{a_logreg_auroc}} | {{a_logreg_sens}} [{{a_logreg_sens_ci}}] | {{a_logreg_spec}} [{{a_logreg_spec_ci}}] | {{a_logreg_ppv}} | {{a_logreg_ppv1}} |
| External (PTB-XL) | {{ext_auroc}} | {{ext_sens}} [{{ext_sens_ci}}] | {{ext_spec}} [{{ext_espe_ci}}] | {{ext_ppv}} | – |
| RR baseline, internal | {{a_baseline_rr_auroc}} | {{a_baseline_rr_sens}} | {{a_baseline_rr_spec}} | {{a_baseline_rr_ppv}} | {{a_baseline_rr_ppv1}} |

Calibration: ECE {{a_logreg_ece}} internal and {{cal_ext_ece}} external, but externally the intermediate
probabilities are overconfident ({{cal_lo}}–{{cal_hi}} predicted → {{cal_obs_lo}}–{{cal_obs_hi}} observed AFIB). Simulated false alerts per day with {{vote_n}}-of-{{vote_m}}
voting on PTB-XL: {{h_ptb_v}} if windows were independent, {{h_corr_ptb}} with correlated errors, and
{{h_ect_lo}}–{{h_ect_hi}} for a person with frequent ectopy.

## Known failure modes

- **Specificity drops out of distribution** ({{a_logreg_spec}} → {{ext_spec}} on PTB-XL). At the frozen
  operating point the RR baseline makes fewer errors than this model on PTB-XL.
- **Look-alike rhythms are called AFIB:** atrial flutter {{g_fl_sh}}, atrial tachycardia {{g_at}}, ectopy up to
  {{g_ect_ptb}}, sinus arrhythmia up to {{g_sa_ptb}} of windows.
- **Altered rate outside the training source:** false-AFIB rate {{e_ptb_brady}} in PTB-XL sinus bradycardia
  and {{e_ptb_tachy}} in sinus tachycardia.
- **Noise:** under muscle noise at {{snrm6}} dB, specificity is {{f_mam6_nosqi}} without SQI and {{f_mam6_cal}} with the
  recalibrated SQI.

## Bias and subgroups

AFIB patients in the data are much older than sinus patients (age is a strong confounder). In the internal test,
the astronaut-like age band ({{age_band}} years) has only {{sub3054_pos}} AFIB windows (sensitivity
{{sub3054_sens}}, specificity {{sub3054_spec}} [{{sub3054_spec_ci}}]). Specificity is lower in patients aged {{age_old}}
({{sub70_spec}}). Populations: Chinese (Shaoxing) training data and German (PTB-XL) external data. Other
ancestries, healthy young adults, exercise, posture changes and microgravity are not represented.

## Ethical considerations

A false sense of security (missed AFIB) and alarm fatigue (false alerts) are both possible. The model must not
drive treatment decisions. Outputs should go to a qualified clinician together with the raw ECG.
